correctness.rationale: PASS: For every height≤2 poset, incidence multiplication makes the strict-interval radical square zero. Solving aba=a vertexwise and edgewise proves a is regular exactly when each edge coordinate connecting two ZERO diagonal endpoints vanishes. For diagonal-zero set T there are (q−1)^(n−|T|) q^(m−e_G(T)) choices, giving the exact all-prime-power count. Inclusion--exclusion of bad edges gives Σ_{F⊆E}(−1)^|F|(q−1)^|F|/q^(|F|+|V(F)|), and the q^(−3) coefficient m+h(G) arises only from singleton and incident-edge-pair sets (bipartite triangle-free). Independent evaluation for all q=2..16 reproduces the path/star degree-7 polynomials and difference q(q−1)^3. More strongly, a freshly written direct linear-system solver (no use of this criterion) counts (path,star) regular elements as (89,91) over F2, (1777,1801) over F3 and (14377,14485) over F4. Simultaneous diagonal idempotent conjugacy and weighted tree-coloring prove that every commuting idempotent t-tuple count equals 2^t[1+(2^t−1)q]^3; independently checked 16 t,q parameter pairs. Includes char2 and isolated vertices; asymptotic keeps graph fixed.
